Breaking News  East‑Kolionia unrest escalates  
Kestrahaim, The Kingdom of Ekpatanus  18 September 2025

Reports from East‑Kolionia indicate a sharp escalation in separatist activity within the Taurus-populated regions. Over the past 48 hours, demonstrations have intensified into widespread street clashes between local separatist groups and East‑Kolionian security forces.

According to field correspondents, several urban centers in the eastern sector have witnessed barricades, burning vehicles, and exchanges of small-arms fire. The unrest follows weeks of political tension, with the Taurus community  an ethnic group with historical and cultural ties to Ekpatanus  calling for independence from East‑Kolionia and integration into the Kingdom of Ekpatanus.

In response to what it describes as a deteriorating security and humanitarian situation, the Ministry of Defense of Ekpatanus has confirmed the initiation of a limited military operation aimed at protecting the Taurus population and ensuring their safety. No official details have been released regarding the scale of the deployment, but eyewitness accounts report the movement of Ekpatanian military units toward the border region.

The government of East‑Kolionia has not yet issued a formal statement on the operation. International observers are monitoring the situation closely, warning that the conflict could escalate further if a political resolution is not reached.

[quote=pantagruel;60325727][nation]Shahzada[/nation] rp

[b]Involvment in Astanir[/b]

[i]Shocked by the erratic upshoot of conflict and division among the Astaniran republic, the Confederacy has decided the most logical step to take is to directly intervene militarily in hope to establish a humanitarian safe zone that civillians will be able to evacuate to. The location of this safe zone has been up to debate, but currently Pantagruel is seeking to establish an occupational force within the archipelago southeast to Astanir.

Pantagruel will NOT be intervening on any side's behalf within this conflict, and wishes to be the staging ground of peaceful diplomatic talks and resolutions. All sides are invited to the Pantagrueli capital of Teremok where diplomatic talks will be held. 

While Pantagruel's actions may seem virtuous and as the paragon of peace, the interests of the state is still at hand. The archipelago of interest is situated in a major concentration of deep-sea resources that the Pantagruel wishes to gain access to, these resources may include Crude Oil, Natural Gas, and Rare Earth Minerals. An occupation of these territories and the future annexation is seen with much ecstasy.[/i]

[pre]As the rays of dawn lit across the Green Giant, military bases littered all over the nation roared to life. Transport aircraft and aerial divisions were readied, while Strike and Aerial Supremacy fighters intensified their daily patrols, some reaching as far as a mere 50KM of the Astaniran coast. The window of oppurtunity only shortened as time passes, and the Confederacy knew this. 

Months before the operation, Pantagrueli spies infiltrated Astanir, their missions remained simple and covert. Over a 2 month period, an almalgamation of maps received by Astaniri locals helped the spies create a rough canvas of what the island Archipelago looked like, and then the most esteemed military strategists estimated where possible SAM launch sites could be. Every single bit of information was crucial to the operation, maps torn apart and rebuilt again to perfectly reflect the Astaniri republic onto their canvas. 

By late morning, all military positions were rallyed accordingly and readied. An airborne Armada lifted into the air, consisting of transport, air supremacy, strike, tanker, and reconnaisance air craft. The spearhead of the attack was the reconnaisance head, which consisted of the most nimble aircraft of the Pantagrueli fleet, making them the paragon of their specialty. If the aircraft detected a potential threat or an enemy encampment, a squadron of 2 air supremacy and a strike fighter were dispatched to the marked zone, where they'd focus on neutralizing the target as quickly as possible before it could prove a threat to the aerial Armada. This created a divide and conquer narrative, where the recon aircraft would cycle information continously to its adversaries.  

Now it was a question on not if Astanir could respond, but how it would respond to such a formidable threat.[/pre]

[nation]Astanir[/nation][/quote]

The invitation for peace talks would be viewed in a variety of ways by the various factions of the war.

The Astaniran National Forces would neglect to even acknowledge the Pantagrueli request, continuing their rapid advances against the Armed Restoration Front like nothing had happened.

The Armed Restoration front would deliberate over the issue greatly. Their lack of coherent leadership would put a thorn in their side and after much intense debate, nothing could be solidly agreed upon for now, leading them to also ignore the invitation.

The Democratic Army however would accept the invitation unanimously, citing their heavy losses and wish for peace. General Haru Arono would be flown to Teremok to engage in negotiations.

The Argossian militias, now somewhat working together thanks to the diplomatic efforts of Nordiheim would also choose to accept negotiations, but would remain skeptical of Pantagruels true intentions. Grand Chieftain Uuki-suk Makoli would represent the Hukuwy-Lukywa tribe, Chieftain Ogjokam Alisan would represent the Tshukwa tribe and high leader Ukugwaka would be sent to represent the Hgajawk tribe.

The Amaralo peoples army would be quick to accept negotiations given their very pro-pantagrueli stance. They would use this as an opportunity to bring Pantagruel over to their side and help them gain independence from the rest of Astanir, or even better take over the Astaniran government. Guoing Lokoa would be sent forth as the leader of the Amaralan Astanir movement.
